_comment: UC-PB-02 Jar Split. Tone rule: the feedback never tells a student to want less. When needs eat the income that is a fact about their life, not a mistake they made.
hook: Your money for the month has arrived. Decide where it goes before it decides for you.
prompt: Share it out between the three jars. The bills are already attached to Needs.
summary: You made a plan for the month.

concept.jars: Split your money the moment it arrives: what you must pay, what you choose to spend, and what you keep.

verdict.missed_bills: Some bills did not get paid this month. Those do not disappear — they arrive again next month, usually bigger.
verdict.heavy_needs: Most of your money has to go to needs. That is not a mistake, it is your situation — and even {amount} in Future is a strong start.
verdict.nothing_future: Everything is spoken for, and nothing was kept. Try moving even one coin to Future and see how the month feels.
verdict.good: Bills covered, and {amount} kept for later. That is what a working plan looks like.
verdict.all_future: You kept almost everything. That is impressive — but a month with no Wants at all is hard to repeat. A plan you can stick to beats a perfect one.
